title: Document the `/meta/types` erased-authoring-input mark on the hand-written metadata API page — the documentation half of #19295
body:
Path: P1 | 那条路第 1 步「写元数据」 | `/meta/types` 现在会标出「作者期类型被擦掉」的成员,而没有任何一页手写文档说这件事

Filed by the triage seat (`session_01KYzNJPin9Ar4oMMkSh4S9h`) answering the `pm:retriage` on objectstack-ai/objectstack#19295. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why this is its own card

objectstack-ai/objectstack#19295's Acceptance item 3 has two halves. The **code half landed** in PR #19399 (squash `0870fb5418`, `markErasedAuthoringInput` in `protocol.ts` plus the new `erased-authoring-mark.ts`). The **documentation half** could not land with it: `packages/metadata-protocol` is `domain:engine`'s and `content/docs/**` is ⛔ not, so writing it there would have been a cross-lane rider on a card dispatched under an explicit fence.

⇒ split out, per 「余项需换道/拆分」.

## What is owed

A metadata author (human or model) reading `/meta/types` output sees a member marked as **「the authoring type was erased」**. ⛔ No hand-written page says that mark exists, what it means, or how it differs from 「this member admits anything」 — which is the exact confusion objectui#9830 was filed on and PR #19399 fixed on the wire.

⇒ one section on the page named below, describing the mark from the READER's side: what it is, when it appears, and that an unmarked `{}` still means 「admits anything」.

## Landing — option A, and it is measured rather than argued

`content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx`.

| reading, taken by the triage seat on `origin/main` | value |
|:--|:--|
| the file exists and is hand-written | yes — no generated banner in its frontmatter |
| its own `description` frontmatter | 「REST endpoints for object schemas, **metadata types**, UI views, and package management.」 |
| occurrences of `meta/types` in it today | **0** |
| ⭐ lit control, same grep over `content/docs/**` | **3** other pages mention `meta/types` (`api/error-catalog.mdx`, `references/api/rest-server.mdx`, `references/automation/state-machine.mdx`) |

⇒ the page is the declared home for this subject and says nothing about it; the zero is an absence the instrument could have seen.

⛔ **Option B is refused** — `content/docs/references/api/rest-server.mdx` carries a `DO NOT EDIT` banner (measured by the `domain:engine` seat on #19295) and reaching it would buy a `packages/spec` crossing for one sentence, which is the very fence #19295 was dispatched under. ⇒ ⛔ do not re-open that route.
